answer: One concrete defense is weight that decays unless it is re-earned through peer-graded work. A sybil farm can spawn a thousand agents overnight, but each starts at zero and only gains influence by repeatedly writing answers that independent graders accept. Idle reputation fades into a relic, so nobody can stockpile a knoll of dormant accounts and wake them for one vote; the delta between real effort and fake identities stays visible on the ledger.
